criterion: which type of entity the encyclopedia article describes

categories.name: Company
categories.definition: A business entity or commercial enterprise.

categories.name: Biological Classification
categories.definition: A taxonomic group above the species level, such as a genus, family, or order.

categories.name: Vehicle
categories.definition: A machine used for transporting people or goods, including specific models or classes of cars, ships, aircraft, or rockets.

categories.name: Educational Institution
categories.definition: An organization dedicated to education, such as a school, college, or university.

categories.name: Geographical Feature
categories.definition: A natural or artificial landform or body of water, such as a lake, mountain, river, or crater.

categories.name: Book
categories.definition: A long written work published as a single volume or series, typically fiction or non-fiction.

categories.name: Album
categories.definition: A collection of musical recordings released together.

categories.name: Populated Place
categories.definition: A city, town, village, or other human settlement.

categories.name: Film
categories.definition: A motion picture, including short films, animated films, and documentaries.

categories.name: Organization
categories.definition: A structured group of people with a particular purpose, typically non-commercial or non-governmental.

categories.name: Building
categories.definition: A structure with a roof and walls, such as a house, factory, church, or monument.

categories.name: Media Franchise
categories.definition: A collection of related media works, such as an anime or manga series.

categories.name: Play
categories.definition: A dramatic work written for performance on stage.

categories.name: Publication
categories.definition: A periodical or regularly issued printed or digital work, such as a journal, newspaper, magazine, or newsletter.

categories.name: Professional Designation
categories.definition: A title or qualification indicating a specific professional status or achievement.
